Amumu.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu W Despair. Amumu W Despair deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't build only health. To counter the physical damage reduction from Amumu E Tantrum, use armor penetration or your allies' magic damage.
Amumu.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target Kayn recently damaged, so hit with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash first. When Amumu's key crowd control is coming, use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to dive in and dodge it, then emerge toward your escape route.
Amumu.escape: Enter when Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are both down. If both are available, don't stay in a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step for long.
Amumu.fight: Engage after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so use Kayn Q Reaping Slash to close in and hit him with Kayn W Blade's Reach, but don't stay in range of Amumu W Despair longer than necessary.
Amumu.phase: In the mid game, Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential, while Rhaast's teamfight sustain improves as he builds items. Shadow Assassin can die easily in late-game teamfights, so choose your entry timing more carefully.
Amumu.teamfight: If Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, spread out from your allies and fight in open terrain. Once Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down, Shadow Assassin should flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and target a damage dealer.
Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, it stuns you, and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy can then catch nearby allies too. Dodge Amumu Q Bandage Toss from behind minions or jungle monsters, and don't group with allies while Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available.
Amumu.laning: Before transforming, farm camps and collect orbs; avoid reckless jungle invades aimed at exploiting a weak early game. When ganking, time Kayn E Shadow Step through the wall behind the lane to cut off the escape route as your ally trades, then look to cast Kayn W Blade's Reach as soon as you emerge from the wall.

Belveth.build: Build armor first against Bel’Veth’s main damage from Bel’Veth Q Void Surge and Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom. Resistance does not work against the true damage from Bel’Veth R Endless Banquet, so consider health too; lowering her attack speed can also help reduce the damage from her basic attacks.
Belveth.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow Bel’Veth with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. If Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, hold your damaging abilities until it ends. After first damaging her with Kayn W Blade’s Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash, use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to finish her or dodge Bel’Veth’s key ability.
Belveth.escape: Don’t engage just because Bel’Veth Q Void Surge has been used once. Dodge Bel’Veth W Above and Below, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash when you can catch her with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, before Bel’Veth Q Void Surge comes back up.
Belveth.fight: Kayn is weak before transforming, so collect orbs by clearing camps instead of forcing direct fights. When fighting, sidestep Bel’Veth W Above and Below to delay her chase, then use Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn W Blade’s Reach after Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends.
Belveth.laning: Use Kayn E Shadow Step to move quickly between camps and clear your jungle fully early. When ganking, approach through the wall behind the lane as your ally starts trading, emerge immediately, and look for an opening after Bel’Veth W Above and Below or Bel’Veth Q Void Surge goes down. Even if you have a chance to slow Bel’Veth’s early growth, don’t enter the enemy jungle after using both Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn E Shadow Step.
Belveth.phase: Bel’Veth is weakest early, before she has stacks, but Kayn is also weak before transforming. Clear camps safely early and look for a sure opportunity to slow Bel’Veth’s growth. In the mid game, make use of Kayn’s strength after transforming: the Shadow Assassin should take assassination opportunities from just after transforming through the mid game, while Rhaast excels in long fights as he builds items. Bel’Veth’s stacks are permanent and make her stronger over time, so don’t take the same kinds of fights as readily late game.
Belveth.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait for Bel’Veth W Above and Below to go down, then flank and target a damage dealer. Use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to dodge the enemy’s attacks as you escape. If Bel’Veth transforms after getting a Void Coral, delay the teamfight and back off before she picks up the coral left where an ally fell.
Belveth.watch: Bel’Veth W Above and Below knocks Kayn up and resets Bel’Veth Q Void Surge, so sidestep when she engages. While Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, her damage taken is greatly reduced, so hold Kayn Q Reaping Slash until it ends.

Brand.combo: Approach over a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then follow up with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target Kayn recently damaged, so use it to finish after hitting with W or Q.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so when Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, you have a chance to close the distance. If you are ablaze, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear before engaging.
Brand.fight: The moment Brand W Pillar of Flame goes down is your chance to engage. Approach with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and deal damage.
Brand.laning: Before transforming, farm jungle camps and collect orbs instead of forcing fights. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step to cross the wall behind the lane and cut off the escape route as your ally starts trading.
Brand.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of fighting early. Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential from right after transforming through the mid game, while Rhaast's teamfight sustain improves as he builds items.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from allies to prevent Brand E Conflagration from spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm from bouncing between you. As Shadow Assassin, target Brand from the flank after Brand Q Sear is down. As Rhaast, engage after key crowd control is used on your frontline and hit multiple enemies with your abilities.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your maximum health and stacks when you are hit by spells in quick succession, then explodes. Dodge Brand Q Sear or Brand W Pillar of Flame, his first spell, and if you are ablaze, get out of the path of Brand Q Sear's projectile.

Briar.build: Build armor first against the damage from Briar's main abilities: P Crimson Curse, Q Head Rush, and W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Also account for the magic damage from Briar E Chilling Scream and R Certain Death, but dodging Briar Q Head Rush takes priority over stacking more resistance. If the fight will last a long time, build healing reduction after resistances.
Briar.combo: Emerge from the wall with Kayn E Shadow Step and hit with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. First damage Briar with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash to meet the condition for Kayn R Umbral Trespass, then use it to finish her. If you're Rhaast and see Briar E Chilling Scream charging, prioritize interrupting it with Kayn W Blade's Reach.
Briar.escape: Don't engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down. Check that Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and R Certain Death are also down, and especially look for an opening before Briar R Certain Death comes back up. Then close the distance with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn R Umbral Trespass, and hit with Kayn W Blade's Reach.
Briar.fight: Before transforming, avoid forcing duels with Briar and focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs. In a fight, wait for Briar to engage, then lock down her movement with Kayn W Blade's Reach and close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. When Briar E Chilling Scream is about to hit, use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to dive in and dodge it, then emerge toward your escape route.
Briar.laning: Early on, clear your camps to transform sooner and avoid fights with Briar in areas without vision. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step through the wall behind the lane to cut off the escape route, then emerge immediately. Use Kayn W Blade's Reach after an ally's crowd control lands or Briar's mobility is down.
Briar.phase: Early on, watch for Briar's frequent ganks, and prioritize camp clears and orb collection while Kayn is weak before transforming. In the mid game, look for flank opportunities when transformed as Shadow Assassin, whose assassination potential is strong. Rhaast has greater sustain in late-game teamfights after building items than right after transforming, so look for extended fights.
Briar.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, once Briar's key crowd control is down, flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and target one damage dealer. As Rhaast, engage after crowd control is used on your frontline and knock up multiple enemies with Kayn W Blade's Reach. While Briar is using W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, she chases the nearest enemy, so block her path from the front to protect your damage dealers.
Briar.watch: Dodge Briar Q Head Rush first, as it stuns and reduces armor and magic resistance. When Briar E Chilling Scream is charging, don't stand with your back to a wall; as Rhaast, interrupt it with the knockup from Kayn W Blade's Reach. If hit by Briar R Certain Death, move toward your allies and fight back together instead of trying to escape alone.

Diana.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor on your first purchase. Diana's main damage is magic damage, so magic resistance helps you survive.
Diana.combo: Once Diana E Lunar Rush is down and the shield from Diana W Pale Cascade is gone, approach with Kayn E Shadow Step and slow her with Kayn W Blade's Reach. Follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks, then finish with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target Kayn recently damaged, so hit with W or Q first.
Diana.escape: The moment Diana uses E Lunar Rush without a mark from Q Crescent Strike is your window to engage. Close the distance with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and slow her with Kayn W Blade's Reach. In teamfights, flank after Diana R Moonfall is down.
Diana.fight: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike sideways and fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone. If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without a mark, slow her with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. If you are hit by Q's mark, create distance instead of chasing.
Diana.laning: Before transforming, farm camps and collect orbs instead of forcing a jungle invade. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step through the wall behind the lane to cut off the escape route as your ally starts trading. Emerge from the wall and cast Kayn W Blade's Reach immediately; it is easier to hit after Diana E Lunar Rush is down.
Diana.phase: Early on, Kayn is weak before transforming, so prioritize camp clears and orb collection. After transforming, Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential in the mid game, while Rhaast's sustain increases as the game approaches late-game teamfights.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from allies so several aren't pulled by Diana R Moonfall, and watch for Diana's flank. As Shadow Assassin, once Diana R Moonfall is down, circle around the flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and target a damage dealer. As Rhaast, engage after key crowd control is used on your frontline and hit multiple enemies with Kayn W Blade's Reach.
Diana.watch: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike sideways, as it curves through the air. If it hits, its mark can let Diana E Lunar Rush engage again, so create distance. Don't close in until the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone, and spread out so Diana R Moonfall doesn't hit several allies at once.

Ekko.build: The data alone doesn't determine your first purchase. Given the damage from Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, Ekko Q Timewinder, and Ekko W Parallel Convergence, build magic resistance over armor. Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn E Shadow Step provide mobility, but if you're likely to get stunned by Ekko W Parallel Convergence when those are unavailable, consider tenacity first.
Ekko.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step. After Ekko E Phase Dive is down, slow him with Kayn W Blade's Reach, or knock him up if you're Rhaast. Follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks, then finish with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target Kayn recently damaged, so hit with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash first.
Ekko.escape: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the area and dodge the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. Your chance to engage comes after Ekko E Phase Dive and Ekko W Parallel Convergence are down, especially while Ekko R Chronobreak is also down. Close the distance with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn R Umbral Trespass, then hit with Kayn W Blade's Reach to limit his chance to escape.
Ekko.fight: Start the fight after dodging the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don't overextend to finish him in one go; engage fully after it is down.
Ekko.laning: Kayn is weak before transforming, so early on focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of forcing fights or invading the jungle. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step to approach through the wall behind the lane and cut off the escape route as your ally starts trading. Kayn W Blade's Reach is easier to hit after Ekko E Phase Dive is down or an ally's crowd control lands.
Ekko.phase: Early on, Kayn is weak before transforming, so farm camps to transform sooner instead of forcing fights with Ekko. Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential from right after transforming through the mid game, so look for an opening when Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. Rhaast's teamfight sustain improves as he builds items, while Shadow Assassin can die easily in late-game teamfights, so choose your entry timing carefully.
Ekko.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, after Ekko W Parallel Convergence is down, approach from the flank or behind with Kayn E Shadow Step and target one damage dealer. Use Kayn R Umbral Trespass on a target you have damaged to avoid the opponent's attack, then emerge toward your escape route.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid both the stun and shield. Also step out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If you see Ekko's afterimage behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don't recklessly chase even when his health is low.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise's main ability damage. Also consider armor against her basic attack damage, and consider tenacity if you are often caught by Cocoon.
Elise.combo: Approach with Kayn E Shadow Step, hit with Kayn W Blade's Reach to slow, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target Kayn has damaged, so land W or Q first, then use R to finish.
Elise.escape: The moment Elise E Cocoon / Rappel's Cocoon and E Rappel are both down is your chance to counter-engage. Even just after Elise moves with Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite, close the distance with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and block her escape route with Kayn W Blade's Reach.
Elise.fight: Before transforming, avoid early fights with Elise and focus on clearing camps. Once Elise E Cocoon / Rappel's Cocoon and E Rappel are down, catch her with Kayn W Blade's Reach and close the distance with Kayn Q Reaping Slash to fight.
Elise.laning: Secure ample vision early and don't push the lane recklessly while Elise is missing.
Elise.phase: Early on, Elise's ganks are threatening and Kayn is weak before transforming, so avoid giving up kills and farm camps. In the mid game, play according to Kayn's transformed form. Shadow Assassin looks for assassinations from right after transforming through the mid game, while Rhaast can last longer in teamfights as he builds items.
Elise.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, once Elise E Cocoon / Rappel's Cocoon is down, flank and target one damage dealer, then use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to avoid the opponent's attack and emerge toward your escape route.
Elise.watch: If Elise E Cocoon / Rappel's Cocoon hits you, Elise can engage with R Spider Form while you're stunned. Dodge Cocoon with a minion or jungle monster between you, and when Elise transforms with R Spider Form, use Kayn Q Reaping Slash or Kayn R Umbral Trespass if its condition is met to avoid her finishing attack.

Evelynn.build: Buy magic resistance first against the magic damage from Evelynn Q Hate Spike and E Whiplash. Evelynn W Allure reduces your magic resistance, and Evelynn E Whiplash deals damage based on your maximum health, so prioritize retreating before the mark matures over building a lot of health.
Evelynn.combo: Approach over a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target Kayn recently damaged, so hit with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Q Reaping Slash first. When Evelynn's key ability is coming, dodge it with Kayn R Umbral Trespass, then emerge toward your escape route and keep dealing damage.
Evelynn.escape: Don't rush to engage when only Evelynn E Whiplash is down, as she can escape with Evelynn R Last Caress. Wait until before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up and after you've dodged the charm from Evelynn W Allure, then approach with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and hit with Kayn W Blade's Reach.
Evelynn.fight: Keep your distance before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, and catch Evelynn with Kayn W Blade's Reach when she engages. After Evelynn R Last Caress is down, close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and R Umbral Trespass to fight.
Evelynn.laning: Before transforming, prioritize clearing camps and collecting orbs over forcing a jungle invade. Place vision beside jungle camps where Evelynn might start a fight, and immediately alert your allies and retreat when you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure. When ganking, time Kayn E Shadow Step through the wall behind the lane to cut off the escape route as your ally starts trading.
Evelynn.phase: Shadow Assassin Kayn has strong assassination potential from right after transforming through the mid game, but can die easily in late-game teamfights, so look for flank opportunities during that period. Rhaast Kayn has better teamfight sustain after building items than right after transforming.
Evelynn.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin Kayn, once Evelynn W Allure is down, flank and target a damage dealer, then use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to dodge the opponent's attack and escape. As Rhaast Kayn, engage after the opponent's key crowd control is used on your frontline, then knock up multiple enemies with Kayn W Blade's Reach and sustain through the fight. If Evelynn gets behind your allies, catch her with Kayn W Blade's Reach.
Evelynn.watch: When you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, retreat before the charm lands. At low health, watch out for the high damage from Evelynn R Last Caress and don't stay in areas without vision.

Fiddlesticks.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can escape the announced area of Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. Build magic resistance over armor to withstand his damage.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Approach over a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, hit with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target Kayn recently damaged, so hit with W or Q first, then use R to finish or dodge one of Fiddlesticks' key abilities.
Fiddlesticks.escape: In teamfights, enter from the flank after Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is down, and position toward your escape route when emerging from Kayn R Umbral Trespass.
Fiddlesticks.fight: If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is available, don't recklessly engage first; look for a chance to avoid his key ability with Kayn R Umbral Trespass.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Before transforming, farm camps and collect orbs instead of forcing a jungle invade. When ganking, approach through the wall behind the lane with Kayn E Shadow Step, but emerge immediately in time with your ally's damage trade, since your position inside the wall is visible. If Fiddlesticks is missing, check vision in the brush behind the lane.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early on, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of fighting. Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential from right after transforming through the mid game, but can die easily in late-game teamfights. Rhaast has better teamfight sustain after building items than right after transforming.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, E Reap, and R Crowstorm are area-of-effect abilities, so spread out from allies and don't bunch up in narrow paths without vision. As Shadow Assassin, target a damage dealer from the flank after Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is down. As Rhaast, engage after key crowd control is used on your frontline, hit multiple enemies with Kayn W Blade's Reach, and sustain through the fight.
Fiddlesticks.watch: If you see Fiddlesticks channeling Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, interrupt it with Kayn W Blade's Reach. If you can’t, move out of range. When Fiddlesticks is out of sight, watch for ambushes from bushes and fear from abilities cast outside your vision. Don’t walk past a Scarecrow Effigy without checking beside it.

Gragas.build: Kayn’s physical damage is less effective against Gragas’s high armor, so build penetration early. For defense against Gragas’s main damage, build magic resistance rather than armor. Since Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on maximum health, avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Gragas.combo: After Gragas E Body Slam is down, approach with Kayn E Shadow Step and hit him with Kayn W Blade's Reach. Follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash to stay on him and land basic attacks, then finish with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target an enemy you recently damaged, so hit them first with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash.
Gragas.escape: The moment after Gragas E Body Slam is down is your chance to engage with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. When one of Gragas’s key abilities is coming in, use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to enter the target and avoid it, then emerge facing your escape route. Kayn E Shadow Step lasts less time during combat, so don’t rely on it to escape.
Gragas.fight: When you see Gragas W Drunken Rage’s drinking animation, focus your attacks after its damage reduction ends. Use Kayn Q Reaping Slash to close the gap as soon as Gragas E Body Slam is down, then use Kayn W Blade's Reach to stop him escaping. Don’t fight where Gragas has placed a barrel; leave its radius first.
Gragas.laning: Before transforming, farm camps and collect orbs rather than forcing fights with Gragas or venturing deep into the jungle. When ganking, time Kayn E Shadow Step through the wall behind the lane to emerge just as your ally trades damage. Kayn W Blade's Reach is easier to land after Gragas E Body Slam is down or your ally has applied crowd control.
Gragas.phase: Early on, Kayn is weak before transforming, while Gragas has strong burst and teamfight disruption in the early and mid game, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs. In the mid game, Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential, but engage after Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas R Explosive Cask are down. In the late game, Gragas’s sustained damage falls off while a well-itemized Rhaast gains teamfight durability, giving you more room to stay in extended fights.
Gragas.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait until Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas R Explosive Cask are down, then flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and target a damage dealer. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you, leave the radius of Gragas Q Barrel Roll before trying to fight back.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius before it explodes. If you also get hit by Gragas E Body Slam near the barrel, the damage and crowd control will overlap, so keep your distance while both abilities are available. If Gragas has Gragas R Explosive Cask, avoid standing with an enemy turret or the enemy team behind you.

Graves.build: Since Graves’s main damage is physical, build armor first and get Plated Steelcaps early. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen.
Graves.combo: After approaching with Kayn E Shadow Step, if Graves E Quickdraw is down, slow him with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then use Kayn Q Reaping Slash to stay on him and land basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target an enemy you recently damaged, so hit them with W or Q before finishing. If one of the enemy’s key abilities is coming in, avoid it with R and emerge facing your escape route.
Graves.escape: Keep in mind that Graves can still create distance with Graves R Collateral Damage when only Graves E Quickdraw is down. Close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and R Umbral Trespass before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back, especially during the window when E is also down, and hit him with Kayn W Blade's Reach.
Graves.fight: Fight back when Graves has fired two basic attacks and is reloading. Fight in open terrain where you have room to avoid the explosion from Graves Q End of the Line, and use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to avoid the moment his key ability comes in.
Graves.laning: Before transforming, farm camps fully and collect orbs rather than forcing jungle invades. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step through a wall behind the lane to cut off the escape route as your ally starts trading damage. Your position inside the wall is visible to enemies, so don’t wait long; emerge right away.
Graves.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming in the early game, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of fighting. From right after transforming through the mid game, Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential, but dies easily in late-game teamfights. Rhaast gains teamfight durability as he builds items, while Graves also gets stronger as he builds, so pressure his growth early.
Graves.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait until the enemy crowd control is down, then flank with Kayn E Shadow Step to target a damage dealer and use Kayn R Umbral Trespass’s untargetable window. Keep an ally or unit between you and Graves to absorb his basic attacks.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line explodes immediately when it hits terrain, so don’t fight with your back to a wall. If you get caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area by the shortest route before re-engaging. Graves P New Destiny’s basic attack is blocked by the first unit it hits, so keep an ally or minion between you and Graves in a skirmish.

Hecarim.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge. Keep in mind that armor won’t block the magic damage from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread or Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows.
Hecarim.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, then slow Hecarim with Kayn W Blade's Reach. Follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash to stay on him and land basic attacks, then finish with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target an enemy you recently damaged, so hit them first with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash.
Hecarim.escape: Don’t engage just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down; wait for Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows to be down as well. Then close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and slow him with Kayn W Blade's Reach to make it harder for him to escape. When one of Hecarim’s key attacks is coming in, avoid it with Kayn R Umbral Trespass and emerge facing your escape route.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, use Kayn W Blade's Reach to slow Hecarim, reducing both his ability to approach and his damage.
Hecarim.laning: Kayn is weak before transforming, so farm camps and collect orbs early rather than forcing jungle invades. When ganking, time Kayn E Shadow Step to emerge from a wall behind the lane as your ally trades damage, cutting off Hecarim’s escape route.
Hecarim.phase: Kayn comes online after transforming. Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential from right after transforming through the mid game. Rhaast gains teamfight durability as he builds items, while Shadow Assassin can die easily in late-game teamfights.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t fear several of you at once. As Shadow Assassin, flank and target a damage dealer after Hecarim E Devastating Charge and Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows are down. As Rhaast, engage after the main crowd control has been used on your frontline, then knock up enemies with Kayn W Blade's Reach and hit several enemies with your abilities to heal and sustain yourself.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks you back farther the farther Hecarim has run, so move toward your allies when Hecarim turns and starts charging to avoid being isolated and knocked back. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear several enemies, so spread out in teamfights. Once you see him engage, use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to avoid his key attack.

Ivern.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, then slow the target with Kayn W Blade's Reach and follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash to stay on them and land basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target an enemy you recently damaged, so hit them first with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash. When one of the enemy’s key abilities is coming in, avoid it with Kayn R Umbral Trespass, then emerge facing your escape route.
Ivern.escape: The moment after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down is your window to engage. Close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash or Kayn R Umbral Trespass, then hit him with Kayn W Blade's Reach to stop him escaping. Watch out for Ivern R Daisy!’s knockup as well, and avoid getting rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller while moving through walls with Kayn E Shadow Step.
Ivern.fight: Right after Ivern uses Ivern Q Rootcaller, close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and catch him with Kayn W Blade's Reach. If Ivern E Triggerseed is already on a target, engage after the shield explodes. Focus on cutting off Ivern’s ally protected by the shield rather than chasing Ivern deep.
Ivern.laning: Before transforming, farm camps and collect orbs rather than forcing an invade into Ivern’s jungle. Ivern plants seeds on camps and returns to harvest them, so use early jungle vision to track his route. When ganking, time Kayn E Shadow Step to approach from a wall behind the lane as your ally trades damage, and watch out for bushes created by Ivern W Brushmaker.
Ivern.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming, so prioritize clearing camps and collecting orbs early and avoid forcing fights. After transforming, Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential through the mid game, but you should choose your late-game teamfight entry carefully. Rhaast gains teamfight durability as he builds items. The provided information isn’t enough to say for certain who is stronger at each stage, Ivern or Kayn.
Ivern.teamfight: Ivern R Daisy! can intercept skillshots, so don’t use non-targeted abilities on an enemy behind Daisy.
Ivern.watch: If you’re rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern’s allies can dash in, so avoid its angle by keeping a minion or terrain between you and Ivern before he casts it. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, reposition to interrupt her repeated attacks and knockups. You can also be hit by the slow when Ivern E Triggerseed explodes on a shielded target, so don’t dive onto that target right away.
Ivern.build: The provided information isn’t enough to determine a first purchase. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Ivern’s damage. However, if allied units joining in after Ivern Q Rootcaller’s root and Ivern R Daisy!’s knockup is the greater threat, consider tenacity first.

JarvanIV.build: Also consider ways to reduce his attack speed later.
JarvanIV.combo: Approach through a wall near the escape route with Kayn E Shadow Step and slow the target with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then use Kayn Q Reaping Slash to stay on them and land basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target an enemy Kayn recently damaged, so hit them first with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash.
JarvanIV.escape: Then close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash, hit them with Kayn W Blade's Reach, and chase.
JarvanIV.laning: Before transforming, farm jungle camps and use Kayn E Shadow Step to cut travel time between camps by crossing walls. Avoid forcing early jungle invades. When ganking, time Kayn E Shadow Step to approach the wall behind the lane as your ally trades damage, then emerge immediately.

Jax.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, then hit Jax with Kayn W Blade's Reach to slow him and follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. After Jax E Counter Strike ends, land basic attacks. Once your earlier abilities have met the condition for your ultimate, finish with Kayn R Umbral Trespass.
Jax.escape: The moment after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike is your chance to close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and hit him with Kayn W Blade's Reach. If Jax E Counter Strike is still available, wait outside its stun radius and engage after he finishes reactivating it.
Jax.fight: Use the window after Jax E Counter Strike is down to trade: hinder his movement with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. Stop basic attacking during Counter Strike and leave its stun radius. If you have already dealt damage to meet your ultimate’s condition, you can use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to avoid a key ability.
Jax.laning: Before transforming, farm camps fully and collect orbs rather than forcing fights. After Jax uses Jax E Counter Strike, approach through a wall behind the lane with Kayn E Shadow Step, cut off his escape route, and gank. Your position inside the wall is visible, so time your approach with your ally’s damage trade and emerge right away.
Jax.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs. After transforming, Shadow Assassin can use his mid-game assassination potential, while Rhaast can fight for longer in teamfights once he has built items.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, don’t group up around him; wait for the area stun to end. As Shadow Assassin, flank with Kayn E Shadow Step after Counter Strike is down and target a damage dealer. As Rhaast, engage after the main crowd control has been used, then sustain yourself by hitting several enemies with Kayn W Blade's Reach.
Jax.watch: Jax E Counter Strike negates basic attacks and stuns when reactivated, so don’t basic attack while it’s active; move out of its stun radius. If Jax closes the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike, watch whether he follows with Counter Strike and save Kayn Q Reaping Slash to create distance.

Karthus.build: All of Karthus’s damage is magic, so prioritize movement speed, then build magic resistance. Before adding more resistance, dodge Karthus W Wall of Pain and spend less time inside Karthus E Defile’s area.
Karthus.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, then hit Kayn W Blade's Reach to slow him. Follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash to close in and land basic attacks, then finish with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target an enemy Kayn recently damaged, so hit Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash first.
Karthus.escape: The enemy can see Kayn’s position inside the wall, so don’t wait long. Come out right away and look to land Kayn W Blade's Reach.
Karthus.fight: Before transforming, farm jungle camps and collect orbs instead of forcing fights. After dodging Karthus W Wall of Pain, approach with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow him with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close in and deal damage with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. Use Kayn R Umbral Trespass after Kayn has dealt damage; you can also dive into a target to avoid one of Karthus’s spells just as it is about to reach you.
Karthus.laning: Early on, use Kayn E Shadow Step to cross walls between camps and clear the jungle faster to speed up your transformation. When ganking, emerge from the wall behind the lane as your ally trades damage and cut off Karthus’s escape route.
Karthus.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early on, so farm jungle camps and look for chances to disrupt Karthus’s growth. Karthus farms quickly and can catch up if you don’t slow his growth early. After transforming, Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential in the mid game but dies easily in late-game teamfights, while Rhaast gains more staying power in teamfights as he builds items.
Karthus.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait until the enemy’s crowd control is down, then flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and target Karthus. As Rhaast, engage after the enemy has used key crowd control on your frontline, hitting multiple enemies with your abilities to heal. Even after killing Karthus, Karthus P Death Defied leaves damage behind, so immediately move away from his corpse and reposition.
Karthus.watch: Karthus W Wall of Pain slows you and reduces your magic resistance, making the follow-up Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus R Requiem more dangerous. Go around the wall, and walk out of Karthus Q Lay Waste’s marked blast area. Karthus can cast spells after dying with Karthus P Death Defied, so move away from his corpse as soon as he is killed.

Khazix.build: Build armor first against the damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear, Kha'Zix W Void Spike, and Kha'Zix E Leap. Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat’s bonus damage is magic damage, so armor won’t block it.
Khazix.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, then slow the target with Kayn W Blade's Reach and use Kayn Q Reaping Slash to stay on them and land basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target an enemy you recently damaged, so hit them first with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash.
Khazix.escape: The moment after Kha'Zix E Leap is down is your chance to engage, so save Kayn W Blade's Reach and land it then. If Kha'Zix becomes invisible with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, wait near your allies and counterattack when he reappears.
Khazix.fight: Before transforming, avoid forcing trades and focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs. Right after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage, hit him with Kayn W Blade's Reach and follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash to stay on him and fight.
Khazix.laning: Early on, clear your jungle fully to transform sooner, and use Kayn E Shadow Step to cross walls between camps. When ganking, emerge from a wall as your ally trades damage and use Kayn W Blade's Reach to block the escape route. Don’t clear camps alone while Kha'Zix knows your position or force an invade into the enemy jungle.
Khazix.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early, so prioritize clearing camps and collecting orbs. From right after transforming through the mid game, Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential, but avoid acting alone in the mid game once Kha'Zix has at least two evolutions. In late-game teamfights, choose Shadow Assassin’s entry carefully; as Rhaast, make use of the increased durability you gain as you build items.
Khazix.teamfight: Stay grouped with your allies so your backline damage dealers aren’t isolated, and watch Kha'Zix’s expected path while he’s invisible with Kha'Zix R Void Assault. As Shadow Assassin, wait until the enemy crowd control is down, then flank to target a damage dealer and escape with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. As Rhaast, engage after the main crowd control has been used on your frontline, then knock up several enemies with Kayn W Blade's Reach and heal as you fight.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals more damage when he isolates you, so fight near an allied champion or minion. If Kha'Zix becomes invisible with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, use Kayn Q Reaping Slash along his expected path rather than chasing his position, and look for the moment he reappears.

Kindred.build: Build armor first against Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. If the duel goes long, consider anti-heal next to counter healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite.
Kindred.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, then hit Kindred with Kayn W Blade's Reach and follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash to stay on her and land basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target an enemy Kayn recently damaged, so land Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash first. When Kindred follows up with key attacks, avoid them with Kayn R Umbral Trespass and emerge facing your escape route.
Kindred.escape: Don’t engage just because Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down; look for the window before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back. Then close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn R Umbral Trespass, and use Kayn W Blade's Reach to block her escape.
Kindred.fight: Before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back, close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and hinder her movement with Kayn W Blade's Reach. If the repeated attacks from Kindred E Mounting Dread become threatening, avoid them with Kayn R Umbral Trespass and emerge facing your escape route.
Kindred.laning: Early on, clear camps fully and use Kayn E Shadow Step to cross walls as you move through the jungle and transform sooner. When ganking, emerge from a wall behind the lane and use Kayn W Blade's Reach to block the escape route as your ally starts trading damage. Take camps marked by P Mark of the Kindred first, or secure vision nearby to delay Kindred from collecting the mark.
Kindred.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early, so prioritize clearing camps and collecting orbs over forcing jungle fights with Kindred. From right after transforming through the mid game, Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential, while Rhaast gains teamfight durability as he builds items. Delay Kindred from collecting P Mark of the Kindred to slow her mid-to-late-game damage and range growth.
Kindred.watch: If you’re marked by Kindred E Mounting Dread, create distance or break vision to avoid letting Kindred keep attacking you. Its damage is more dangerous when your health is low, so look for a window to avoid the enemy’s attack with Kayn R Umbral Trespass.
Kindred.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait until the enemy crowd control is down, then approach Kindred from the flank and use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to avoid attacks and escape. As Rhaast, engage after the main crowd control has been used on your frontline, knock enemies up with Kayn W Blade's Reach, and hit several enemies with your abilities to heal. When Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, enter its area so your low-health allies can survive too.

Lillia.laning: Before transforming, farm camps to speed up your transformation instead of forcing an invade. If you don’t know where Lillia is, don’t walk straight through narrow jungle entrances or river paths. When ganking, emerge from the wall behind the lane with Kayn E Shadow Step as your ally trades damage and cut off the escape route.
Lillia.build: Build magic resistance first against Lillia’s main damage. Armor helps against her basic attacks, but resistance does not reduce the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows. Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough scales with maximum health, so think carefully before choosing to stack large amounts of health alone.
Lillia.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, then hit Kayn W Blade's Reach to slow her and close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash to land basic attacks. Use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to finish after first dealing damage with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash. Right after Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, this is a good sequence for closing the gap.
Lillia.escape: Right after Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, look for a chance to go in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. Keep dodging Lillia’s abilities and wait until she has no movement speed stacks. If you’re hit by an ability that enables Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, retreat to safety while drowsy.
Lillia.fight: Dodge Lillia’s abilities and fight once you’ve prevented her movement speed stacks from building up. Right after Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and lock her down with Kayn W Blade's Reach. While the slam is coming down, you can dive in with Kayn R Umbral Trespass to avoid the attack.
Lillia.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early on, so avoid forcing fights with Lillia and focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs. After transforming, Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential through the mid game, so look for an opening after Lillia’s abilities and mobility are down. Rhaast gains more teamfight staying power as he builds items, so look for angles to hit multiple enemies with your abilities in the late game.
Lillia.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait until the enemy’s crowd control is down, then flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to avoid attacks or escape. Save your immobilizing crowd control so you can catch Lillia when she flanks.
Lillia.watch: Getting hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed enables Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so dodge them even when you have plenty of health. When you see the windup for Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, move sideways to avoid the center, and watch out for Lillia E Swirlseed in narrow jungle paths.

Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, don’t get separated; immediately move toward your allies. As Shadow Assassin, wait for Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to go down, then flank and target a damage dealer. Use Kayn R Umbral Trespass on a target you have damaged to dodge their attack.
Nocturne.watch: If the tether from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror stays connected, it will fear you, so use Kayn Q Reaping Slash to create distance as soon as it connects. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability and increases his attack speed, so don’t use your key attack right away while the shield is up. If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, don’t run straight along its trail; turn toward your allies.
Nocturne.fight: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, break the shield with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in and attack with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, use Kayn Q Reaping Slash to create distance and avoid the fear. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target you have already damaged, so hit Kayn Q Reaping Slash first, then use R to dodge the opponent’s key attack.
Nocturne.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Nocturne Q Duskbringer, and Nocturne R Paranoia. Remember that armor does not apply to the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Nocturne.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, then use Kayn W Blade’s Reach first. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks it, close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash, deal damage, and follow with basic attacks. After dealing damage, use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to dodge the opponent’s attacks or finish them, and emerge toward your escape route.
Nocturne.escape: The window while Nocturne R Paranoia is down is a chance to engage. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is down too, close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and catch him with Kayn W Blade’s Reach.
Nocturne.laning: Before transforming, don’t force fights with Nocturne or invade the jungle; clear camps and collect orbs. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step through the wall behind the lane to cut off the enemy’s escape route, and look for Kayn W Blade’s Reach as you emerge. Keep vision at the river and jungle entrances so you can decide in advance which way to retreat if Nocturne R Paranoia activates.
Nocturne.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early, so prioritize clearing camps and collecting orbs over fighting Nocturne. After transforming, the Shadow Assassin should make use of his mid-game assassination potential, while Rhaast should use his teamfight staying power, which improves as he builds items. The Shadow Assassin can die easily in late-game teamfights, so choose your engage timing carefully.

Rammus.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait until Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and Rammus R Soaring Slam are down, then flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and target the enemy damage dealers. As Rhaast, engage after Rammus’s key crowd control has been used on your frontline, hitting multiple enemies with your abilities to heal. When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, don’t basic attack Rammus; target someone else.
Rammus.laning: Before transforming, don’t force a fight with Rammus or recklessly enter the enemy jungle; farm camps and collect orbs. When ganking, pass through the wall behind the lane with Kayn E Shadow Step and emerge immediately as your ally starts trading damage. Keep a minion between you and Rammus Q Powerball’s path, and use Kayn W Blade's Reach when you have a clear angle to hit it.
Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against Rammus’s main damage. If you choose penetration, prioritize percentage penetration over flat penetration to account for the large resistance increase while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active.
Rammus.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow him with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is off, follow up with basic attacks and finish with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. You must first damage him with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash to use Kayn R Umbral Trespass.
Rammus.escape: Engage after Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and Rammus R Soaring Slam are down. In particular, while Rammus R Soaring Slam is down, close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and catch him with Kayn W Blade's Reach.
Rammus.fight: Back off while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, then deal your damage right after it ends. Use Kayn W Blade's Reach to manage your distance before Rammus E Frenzying Taunt hits you, and close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash after Rammus’s crowd control is down. Use Kayn R Umbral Trespass on Rammus after you’ve damaged him first to avoid a dangerous attack.
Rammus.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early on, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of forcing fights with Rammus. After transforming, Shadow Assassin has strong potential to target damage dealers through the mid game but dies easily in late-game teamfights, so choose your engage timing carefully. Consider Rhaast if the enemy team is mostly melee and durable and you need to fight for longer; Rhaast gains more teamfight staying power as he builds items.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, put a minion between you and him, and move out of Rammus R Soaring Slam’s landing area, which can expand. The landing area stays slowed, so leave it immediately. You can’t dodge Rammus E Frenzying Taunt once it hits, so position outside its range, and stop basic attacking while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active.

Shaco.fight: Before transforming, focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of forcing fights against Shaco’s early invades. Right after Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive, group with your allies to deal damage, slow him with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash.
Shaco.laning: Maintain vision at your jungle entrances and watch for Shaco’s early ganks and invades. When ganking from a camp, use Kayn E Shadow Step to pass through the wall behind the lane and cut off the escape route. Don’t stay in the wall long; come out immediately and hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach.
Shaco.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, after Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate’s fear are down, flank with Kayn E Shadow Step to target a damage dealer, and use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to dodge the enemy’s attacks. Don’t waste damage on Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone; retreat from the explosion and boxes when it dies.
Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Get enough health to avoid the low-health range where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage, and consider movement speed to get away from boxes.
Shaco.combo: Right after Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive, approach with Kayn E Shadow Step, hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and continue with basic attacks. Use Kayn R Umbral Trespass on a target Kayn has damaged first, and use it when one of Shaco’s key abilities comes in to dodge it, then emerge toward your escape route.
Shaco.escape: The moment after Shaco Q Deceive is used is your opening to close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn R Umbral Trespass. If you suspect Shaco W Jack In The Box is on your entry path, check first. In teamfights, go in after Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate’s fear are down.
Shaco.phase: Early on, Shaco’s ganks and invades are threatening, and Kayn is weak before transforming, so avoid giving up kills and focus on camps and objectives. Kayn’s power starts with transformation: Shadow Assassin has high assassination power right after transforming and through mid game, while Rhaast’s teamfight sustain improves as he builds items. If Shaco’s early lead is stopped and the game goes longer, his ability to fight alone falls off.
Shaco.watch: Watch for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in brush where you have no vision and around objectives; check with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens first. If Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive, adjust your direction so you don’t expose your back. After Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone dies, retreat from that spot to avoid the explosion and boxes.

Vi.laning: Before transforming, clear camps and collect orbs instead of forcing fights with Vi or entering the enemy jungle. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step through the wall behind the lane as your ally trades, cutting off the enemy’s escape route. Your position inside the wall is visible, so don’t wait long; emerge right away.
Vi.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Vi Q Vault Breaker, W Denting Blows, and E Relentless Force. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone. Consider lowering her attack speed as well to take fewer basic attacks.
Vi.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, then slow Vi with Kayn W Blade’s Reach and deal damage with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target Kayn recently damaged, so hit with Kayn W Blade’s Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash first. When Vi’s key ability is coming, use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to enter her and dodge it, then emerge toward your escape route and keep attacking.
Vi.escape: After baiting out Vi Q Vault Breaker is a chance to engage with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. Land Kayn W Blade’s Reach then to prevent Vi from disengaging. If Vi R Cease and Desist is still available, don’t rush your engage; as Rhaast, use Kayn W Blade’s Reach after Vi lands and the knockup ends.
Vi.fight: Right after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker’s dash, close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and land Kayn W Blade’s Reach to chase her. Don’t take many consecutive hits from Vi W Denting Blows; deal damage briefly, then create distance. If Vi engages while Vi P Blast Shield is active, trade after the shield is removed.
Vi.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early, so prioritize clearing camps and collecting orbs over fighting Vi. After transforming, the Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential through the mid game, so act when Vi’s crowd control is down. In late-game teamfights, the Shadow Assassin can die easily, while Rhaast gains more staying power as he builds items.
Vi.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait for Vi Q Vault Breaker and R Cease and Desist to go down, then flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and target one damage dealer. Don’t try to stop Vi R Cease and Desist with forced movement while it is pursuing its target; respond after she lands.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage the longer it is charged, so move back or to the side when you see her charging to dodge it. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor when she keeps hitting the same target, so don’t stay in a fight with her for long. Don’t try to stop Vi with Kayn W Blade’s Reach while she is charging in with Vi R Cease and Desist; use it after she lands and the knockup ends.

MasterYi.fight: Right after Master Yi uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. Once Master Yi lands, hit Kayn W Blade's Reach, then use Kayn R Umbral Trespass after you’ve met its recent-damage requirement. You can’t be targeted while inside Kayn R Umbral Trespass, so use it to avoid the enemy’s attacks before coming out toward your escape route.
MasterYi.teamfight: Respond with your allies so Master Yi doesn’t get the first takedown, and look for an opening right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends. As Rhaast, you can use the knockup from Kayn W Blade's Reach to interrupt Master Yi W Meditate. As Shadow Assassin, wait until the enemy’s crowd control is down before flanking, then use the untargetable window from Kayn R Umbral Trespass to escape.
MasterYi.build: You can’t reduce the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style with resistance, so build some health too. Attack speed reduction also suppresses his basic attack damage and the cooldown reduction on Master Yi Q Alpha Strike.
MasterYi.combo: After Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is down, approach with Kayn E Shadow Step and hit Kayn W Blade's Reach. Follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash to close in and land basic attacks, then finish with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target an enemy Kayn recently damaged, so hit Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash first.
MasterYi.escape: Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is his only mobility tool, so engage with Kayn Q Reaping Slash or Kayn R Umbral Trespass right after he uses it. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, don’t rely on the slow from Kayn W Blade's Reach; respond with Rhaast’s knockup or mobility.
MasterYi.laning: Kayn is weak before transforming, so early on prioritize clearing camps and collecting orbs over forcing an invade. When ganking, emerge immediately through the wall behind the lane with Kayn E Shadow Step as your ally trades damage, and look for Kayn W Blade's Reach after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is down.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early on, but Kayn is weak before transforming too. Farm camps to speed up your transformation and take early objectives you can secure. Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential in the mid game, while Rhaast gains more teamfight staying power as he builds items. Master Yi also grows stronger as the game goes on, so don’t delay taking your early advantages.
MasterYi.watch: You can’t target Master Yi while Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is active, so use Kayn R Umbral Trespass after Master Yi lands. Master Yi E Wuju Style adds true damage to his basic attacks, and Kayn W Blade's Reach cannot slow him while Master Yi R Highlander is active.

RekSai.laning: Clear your jungle fully early to transform sooner, and don’t move alone through areas without vision so Rek’Sai can’t get a kill with her early and mid-game ganks. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step over the wall behind the lane to cut off the escape route as your ally starts trading damage. If you see a Rek’Sai tunnel entrance near a lane or in your jungle, walk over it to destroy it.
RekSai.build: Build armor first against Rek’Sai’s main damage. The true damage from Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel can’t be reduced with resistances, and Rek’Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your max health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. If preparing for extended fights, consider healing reduction and attack speed reduction as well.
RekSai.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target you recently damaged, so hit them with Kayn W Blade’s Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash before using it to finish them. When Rek’Sai’s key attack comes in, dodge it with Kayn R Umbral Trespass, emerge toward your escape route, and keep dealing damage.
RekSai.escape: Your opening is after Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow’s knockup is used and before Rek’Sai R Void Rush comes back up. If only Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel has been used, Rek’Sai can still escape with Rek’Sai R Void Rush. Close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash while her mobility is down, then hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach.
RekSai.fight: Before transforming, focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of forcing trades. Approach after dodging Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow’s knockup or after Rek’Sai R Void Rush is used. If Rek’Sai goes underground again to heal during a fight, don’t give her space; keep dealing damage.
RekSai.phase: Early on, Kayn is weak before transforming, while Rek’Sai looks to build a lead through ganks. Avoid forcing fights; buy time by clearing camps. In mid game after transforming, Shadow Assassin has strong assassination power, while Rhaast’s teamfight sustain improves as he builds items. Shadow Assassin can die easily in late-game teamfights, so choose your entry timing more carefully.
RekSai.watch: When Rek’Sai goes underground with Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, watch for the knockup and move toward open ground, away from walls and narrow paths. If you dodge the knockup with Kayn Q Reaping Slash as she emerges, Rek’Sai loses her way to hold you in place. After Rek’Sai damages you, stay close to your allies because Rek’Sai R Void Rush may follow.
RekSai.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait until the enemy’s crowd control is down, then use Kayn E Shadow Step to flank and target one damage dealer. Use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to avoid an attack and escape. If Rek'Sai enters Burrow, keep dealing damage without giving up ground so she has no time to heal.

Viego.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait for Viego W Spectral Maw to go down, then flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and target one damage dealer. As Rhaast, engage after the enemy’s key crowd control is used on your frontline, then heal by hitting multiple enemies with Kayn W Blade’s Reach and Kayn Q Reaping Slash. If an ally dies, stop Viego from possessing them with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, and don’t keep fighting near the body.
Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If a long duel is likely, next consider a way to reduce the healing from Viego P Sovereign’s Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King.
Viego.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step and slow Viego with Kayn W Blade’s Reach as you emerge. Follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks, then finish with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target you recently damaged, so hit with Kayn W Blade’s Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash first.
Viego.escape: If only Viego W Spectral Maw is down, he can still escape with Viego R Heartbreaker, so don’t rush your engage. Before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back up, use the window when Viego W Spectral Maw is also down to close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach.
Viego.fight: Before transforming, don’t force fights with Viego; clear camps and collect orbs. Once both Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego R Heartbreaker are down, close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash, land Kayn W Blade’s Reach, and cut off his escape route. When Viego’s key attack is coming, use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to dodge it, then emerge toward your escape route.
Viego.laning: Early on, use Kayn E Shadow Step to cross walls between camps as you clear the jungle, and avoid risky invades. When ganking, approach through the wall behind the lane as your ally starts trading, then emerge immediately and look for Kayn W Blade’s Reach. If Viego E Harrowed Path appears on terrain, avoid that route.
Viego.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming, so early on prioritize clearing camps and collecting orbs over fighting Viego. The Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential from just after transforming through the mid game, but dies easily in late-game teamfights, so look for opportunities during that window. Rhaast has more teamfight staying power after building items than right after transforming.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged, so sidestep when you see him charging. As Rhaast, interrupt the charge with the knock-up from Kayn W Blade’s Reach. If you see Viego E Harrowed Path on terrain, watch for Viego camouflaged inside it and take a different route around the area.

Nunu.laning: When ganking, cross the wall behind the lane with Kayn E Shadow Step and cut off the escape route as soon as your ally starts trading damage. The enemy can see Kayn’s position inside the wall, so don’t wait long; come out right away.
Nunu.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait until Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage are down, then flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and target the enemy damage dealers. As Rhaast, engage after their key crowd control has been used on your frontline, hitting multiple enemies with your abilities to heal. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, look for an angle to interrupt it with Rhaast’s Kayn W Blade's Reach; if you can’t interrupt it, leave the area.
Nunu.build: Get Grievous Wounds early to counter the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume. Most of their damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, and get tenacity to help against the crowd control from the snowball.
Nunu.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and land basic attacks. You must first deal damage with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash to use Kayn R Umbral Trespass. When one of Nunu & Willump’s key abilities comes in, dive in with Kayn R Umbral Trespass to avoid it, then come out toward your escape route and keep attacking.
Nunu.escape: The opening to engage is right after the crowd control from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage is down. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance, so close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and catch them with Kayn W Blade's Reach.
Nunu.fight: Before transforming, prioritize clearing camps and collecting orbs over forcing trades. When fighting, wait until Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage are down, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash to deal damage based on maximum health. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance, so keep chasing with Kayn W Blade's Reach once you’re on them.
Nunu.phase: If you choose Shadow Assassin, make use of its assassination potential from transformation through the mid game. If you choose Rhaast, use his teamfight staying power, which improves as he builds items.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls from a distance and knocks you up, so when you see it, move toward the snowball instead of running backward and escape through the path Nunu & Willump came from. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, use Kayn Q Reaping Slash to get out before the delayed root detonates. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, interrupt it with Rhaast’s Kayn W Blade's Reach or immediately leave the area.

Rengar.laning: Kayn is weak before transforming, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs early instead of forcing jungle invades. If Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside brush and use Control Wards to reveal it. When ganking, approach through the wall behind the lane with Kayn E Shadow Step as your ally starts trading damage, then come out immediately.
Rengar.phase: Before transforming, Kayn is weak early, so clear camps to transform sooner instead of forcing fights with Rengar. In mid game, Shadow Assassin Kayn has strong assassination power right after transforming, so look for opportunities when the enemy’s crowd control is down. In late game, Shadow Assassin has a harder time surviving teamfights, while Rhaast Kayn’s teamfight sustain improves as he builds items.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator leaps from brush and builds ferocity, so avoid paths beside brush when he’s out of sight. At full ferocity, Rengar E Bola Strike roots, while Rengar W Battle Roar can remove crowd control, so wait for his ferocity bar to be empty. When he approaches with Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt, stay with your allies instead of roaming alone while injured.
Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar’s main damage. Keep in mind that armor won’t block the magic damage from Rengar W Battle Roar, and your armor is reduced while Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active.
Rengar.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and continue with basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target Kayn recently damaged, so hit them first with Kayn W Blade’s Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash. Using Kayn W Blade’s Reach after Rengar W Battle Roar is down reduces the risk of him removing its crowd control.
Rengar.escape: After letting Rengar E Bola Strike pass without hitting you, go in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. If Rengar W Battle Roar is also down, hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach for a chance to hold him in place. Kayn E Shadow Step has a shorter duration during combat, so don’t rely on it as an escape during a fight.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar’s ferocity bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar is down. Dodge Rengar E Bola Strike, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and keep chasing with Kayn W Blade’s Reach. When Rengar uses a key ability, you can dive in with Kayn R Umbral Trespass to dodge the attack.
Rengar.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, after Rengar E Bola Strike is used, flank with Kayn E Shadow Step to target a damage dealer. As Rhaast, go in after Rengar’s main crowd control has been used on your frontline, hit multiple enemies with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, and sustain through the fight. Against Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt, stay grouped with your allies within vision.

LeeSin.laning: Early on, clear your jungle camps without interruption and use Kayn E Shadow Step to cross walls between them. When ganking, emerge from the wall behind the lane as your ally trades damage and look to land Kayn W Blade's Reach first. Keep a minion or jungle monster between you and Lee Sin so he doesn’t have a clear line for Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike.
LeeSin.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait until Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage is down, then flank and target one damage dealer, using the untargetable window from Kayn R Umbral Trespass. As Rhaast, engage after Lee Sin’s key crowd control has been used on your frontline, hitting multiple enemies with your abilities to heal. Before a teamfight, keep some distance so you don’t collide with an ally knocked back by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
LeeSin.watch: When Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage is ready, don’t give him room to get behind you. Keep some distance from your allies during teamfights.
LeeSin.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple.
LeeSin.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow him with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then deal damage with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target an enemy Kayn recently damaged, so hit Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash first. When Lee Sin’s key ability comes at you, dive in with Kayn R Umbral Trespass to avoid it, then come out toward your escape route and keep attacking.
LeeSin.escape: Don’t go in as soon as Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is down; check whether he can still escape with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will. Before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is available again, look for an opening when Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage is also down. Close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and hit Kayn W Blade's Reach.
LeeSin.fight: Before transforming, avoid early jungle duels with Lee Sin and focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs. If Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses, or before he can cast it again, look for a chance to engage. Close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and pursue with Kayn W Blade's Reach.
LeeSin.phase: Early on, avoid dueling Lee Sin and focus on speeding up Kayn’s transformation. If you choose Shadow Assassin, target the enemy damage dealers from transformation through the mid game. If you choose Rhaast, use his teamfight staying power, which improves as he builds items. You can also buy time until Lee Sin’s strength falls off in the late game by gaining advantages around objectives and lanes.

MonkeyKing.laning: Before transforming, don’t force fights with Wukong or invade his jungle; farm camps to speed up your transformation. When ganking, cross the wall behind the lane with Kayn E Shadow Step and cut off the escape route as soon as your ally starts trading damage. Use Kayn W Blade's Reach after Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down or your ally has landed crowd control.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: While Wukong R Cyclone is ready, keep your distance from allies and don’t engage first. As Shadow Assassin, wait until Wukong R Cyclone is down, then approach from the side with Kayn E Shadow Step and target the enemy damage dealers.
MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong’s main damage. Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor, so prioritize avoiding his empowered basic attacks and consider reducing his attack speed. Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
MonkeyKing.combo: While Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, approach with Kayn E Shadow Step and slow him with Kayn W Blade's Reach. Follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash to close in and land basic attacks, then finish with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target an enemy Kayn recently damaged, so hit Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash first.
MonkeyKing.escape: Engage before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes back up. If only Wukong E Nimbus Strike is down, he can still escape with Wukong W Warrior Trickster, so check whether he has another mobility ability available. In teamfights, go in after Wukong R Cyclone is down.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong builds armor and healing as hits accumulate, so trade short bursts of damage and back off instead of taking a long duel. After Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and hit Kayn W Blade's Reach to prevent his escape. As Wukong R Cyclone comes in, dive in with Kayn R Umbral Trespass after dealing damage first to meet its requirement, and avoid Cyclone.
MonkeyKing.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early on, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of fighting Wukong. Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential from transformation through the mid game but dies easily in late-game teamfights, so look for your chance during that window. Rhaast gains more teamfight staying power once he has built items than immediately after transforming.
MonkeyKing.watch: When Wukong uses Wukong W Warrior Trickster, don’t waste abilities on the stationary clone; watch which way the real one escapes. Wukong E Nimbus Strike is a targeted ability, so manage your distance from outside its range.

Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so several allies aren’t hit together by Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent’s path or Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and Shyvana E Molten Burst. As Rhaast, after Shyvana engages, knock her up with Kayn W Blade’s Reach and sustain through the fight by hitting multiple enemies with your abilities. As Shadow Assassin, wait for the enemy’s crowd control to be used, then flank to target a damage dealer and use Kayn R Umbral Trespass’s untargetable phase.
Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Get armor too for her basic attacks’ physical damage, but don’t rely on stacking health alone because Shyvana Q Emberstrike deals true damage and damage based on your max health.
Shyvana.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash first to meet the condition for Kayn R Umbral Trespass, then finish her. Against Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, don’t try to control her during the dash; hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach after she lands.
Shyvana.escape: After Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is used, she has no way to create distance on her own, so close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and look for a chance to hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach. Right after Shyvana enters with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, dodge her path first and decide whether to engage after she lands.
Shyvana.fight: Look for a fight after Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is used or when her Fury bar is empty. When she sticks close to deal damage with basic attacks and Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, use Kayn W Blade’s Reach’s slow to create distance. If there’s an angle to re-engage, approach with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. When her key damage is about to land, dodge it with Kayn R Umbral Trespass.
Shyvana.laning: Kayn is weak before transforming, so safely clear camps early and collect orbs by making contact with champions. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step over the wall behind the lane to cut off the escape route, then come out immediately instead of waiting in the wall. Shyvana builds stacks through early camps and objectives, so take camps and objectives first when possible while avoiding risky jungle invades.
Shyvana.phase: Shyvana is weak early without stacks, but Kayn is also weak before transforming, so take camps while looking for safe ganks and objective opportunities. Kayn comes online with transformation: Shadow Assassin has strong assassination power in mid game, while Rhaast’s teamfight sustain improves as he builds items. Shyvana’s stacks are permanent, so she becomes more advantageous over time; use early opportunities to limit her scaling.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana Q Emberstrike and Shyvana E Molten Burst deal damage based on your max health, so avoid staying close and taking repeated hits. Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is unstoppable while she flies in, so avoid her path and catch her with Kayn W Blade’s Reach after she lands. If Shyvana’s Fury bar is full, don’t start an objective first.
