Poppy.laning: Before transforming, clear camps to transform sooner instead of forcing a fight with Poppy or invading the enemy jungle. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step to pass through the wall behind the lane and cut off the escape route. Don’t stay inside the wall long; come out immediately and hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. Don’t prioritize magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, approach with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow her with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Deal damage first with Kayn W Blade’s Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash to meet the condition for Kayn R Umbral Trespass, then finish her.
Poppy.escape: The moment after Poppy E Heroic Charge is used is your chance to close the gap. Confirm Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended before going in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. When Poppy’s key ability comes in, dodge it with Kayn R Umbral Trespass, then emerge toward your escape route.
Poppy.fight: If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, stop dashing. Once it ends, slow her with Kayn W Blade’s Reach and close in. After Poppy E Heroic Charge is used, close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash, but don’t fight with your back to a wall.
Poppy.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs early instead of forcing fights with Poppy. After transforming, Shadow Assassin has strong assassination power through mid game, while Rhaast’s teamfight sustain improves as he builds items. Consider Rhaast if the enemy team is mostly melee and durable; consider Shadow Assassin if they have many squishy damage dealers and your team has a frontline.
Poppy.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, flank and target a damage dealer after Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict are used.
Poppy.watch: While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t dash in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash or Kayn R Umbral Trespass; wait for it to end. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so stay in open space. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, leave the remaining zone immediately. If you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, dodge to the side.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr. Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, while Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types, so armor alone cannot block all of it. Consider ways to reduce Udyr’s basic attack damage and attack speed instead of stacking health.
Udyr.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait for Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun to go down, then flank a squishy damage dealer and use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to escape. As Rhaast, engage after the enemy’s key crowd control is used on your frontline, then survive by hitting multiple enemies with Kayn W Blade’s Reach and Kayn Q Reaping Slash. Don’t force attacks onto Udyr once he is tanky from defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle; take out weaker enemies behind him first.
Udyr.combo: Bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede, then approach with Kayn E Shadow Step and hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach as you emerge from the wall. Follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash, basic attacks, and damage, then finish with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. When Udyr’s key attack is coming, use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to enter him and dodge it, then emerge toward your escape route.
Udyr.escape: Right after Udyr E Blazing Stampede goes down is a chance to close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. When catching him with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, wait until Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s empowered state ends.
Udyr.fight: Before transforming, don’t force fights with Udyr. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle wears off, catch him with Kayn W Blade’s Reach and follow with Kayn Q Reaping Slash to deal burst damage. If you’ve already weathered one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, trade back or disengage while it cannot immediately stun the same target again.
Udyr.laning: Clear your camps fully early to transform sooner, and avoid risky jungle invades. Track Udyr’s pathing with vision at key routes and jungle entrances. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step through the wall behind the lane as your ally starts trading, cutting off the enemy’s escape route.
Udyr.phase: Early on, Kayn is weak before transforming, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of fighting Udyr. In the mid game, make use of the Shadow Assassin’s strong assassination window after transforming. In late-game teamfights, the Shadow Assassin can die easily, while Rhaast gains more staying power as he builds items.
Udyr.watch: Watch for Udyr E Blazing Stampede to stun you as soon as it activates, and avoid taking damage while Kayn E Shadow Step carries you through a wall. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay in a fight with him for long. Kayn W Blade’s Reach cannot immobilize Udyr while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered, so use it after the empowerment ends.

Sejuani.laning: Before transforming, clear your jungle fully early and use Kayn E Shadow Step to cross walls between camps and save travel time. When ganking, approach through the wall behind the lane as your ally trades damage, then emerge from the wall and hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach to cut off the escape route. If Sejuani is nearby and Sejuani E Permafrost stacks are building, don’t force an engage.
Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North, Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, and Sejuani E Permafrost. Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath deals physical damage, so magic resistance alone won’t block it. Stacking health alone also increases the damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North.
Sejuani.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target you recently damaged, so hit them first with Kayn W Blade’s Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash. Use it to finish Sejuani or dodge one of her key abilities.
Sejuani.escape: When Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, engage while she has no mobility. As Shadow Assassin, flank after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani E Permafrost, and Sejuani R Glacial Prison are down. Kayn E Shadow Step has a shorter duration during combat and is interrupted by immobilizing effects, so don’t rely on it to escape during a fight.
Sejuani.fight: Right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used, close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash or Kayn R Umbral Trespass and hold her with Kayn W Blade’s Reach. When Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or Sejuani R Glacial Prison comes in, dive in with Kayn R Umbral Trespass if you meet its condition to dodge the attack, then emerge toward your escape route and keep dealing damage.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, Kayn is weak before transforming, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of forcing jungle invades. Sejuani has openings because her early kills and damage are low, but fight when her key abilities are down. After transforming, Shadow Assassin has strong assassination power in mid game but dies easily in late-game teamfights, while Rhaast’s teamfight sustain improves as he builds items.
Sejuani.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani E Permafrost, and Sejuani R Glacial Prison are down, flank with Kayn E Shadow Step to target a damage dealer.
Sejuani.watch: Dodge Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison to the side when you see their windup. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, move out of range before the second strike. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks can also build from basic attacks by nearby melee allies, so create distance as the indicator fills.

Nidalee.build: Build magic resistance first against Nidalee’s main damage. Even with resistance, dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range comes first.
Nidalee.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow her with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target someone Kayn has already damaged, so hit Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash first. When Nidalee’s key attack comes in, dodge it with Kayn R Umbral Trespass, then come out toward your escape route and keep attacking.
Nidalee.escape: Right after making Nidalee use Nidalee W Pounce is Kayn’s chance to engage. Nidalee has no crowd control, so dodge Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack to avoid her mark, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash. If you’re already marked, be ready to hit Kayn W Blade's Reach as Nidalee jumps in with Nidalee W Pounce.
Nidalee.fight: Before transforming, don’t force fights with Nidalee; farm jungle camps and collect orbs. When Nidalee W Pounce is down, close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and hit Kayn W Blade's Reach to pursue her.
Nidalee.laning: Use Kayn E Shadow Step to cross walls between camps while clearing your jungle, and avoid early invades. Watch out for Nidalee W Bushwhack around river and jungle entrances; check with a Control Ward or an area ability before entering. When ganking, cross the wall and cut off the escape route as soon as your ally starts trading damage.
Nidalee.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early on, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of fighting. If you choose Shadow Assassin, look for assassination opportunities from transformation through the mid game. Rhaast gains more staying power in teamfights once he has built items than immediately after transforming.
Nidalee.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait until the other enemies’ crowd control is down, then flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and target a low-durability enemy like Nidalee. As Rhaast, engage after your frontline has absorbed the enemy’s key crowd control and survive by hitting multiple enemies with Kayn W Blade's Reach. Remember where Nidalee steps out to throw her spear, and catch her when Nidalee W Pounce is down.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther it travels, so first dodge the line of the incoming spear. Dodging Nidalee W Bushwhack as well prevents her hunt mark and makes it harder for her to chase you. If you are marked, save Kayn W Blade's Reach for when Nidalee jumps in with Nidalee W Pounce.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Taliyah’s main abilities, Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. There’s no basis here for choosing a specific item.
Taliyah.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash from an angle that avoids the rock field and use basic attacks. Use Kayn R Umbral Trespass after first dealing damage with Kayn W Blade’s Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash. When Taliyah’s key ability comes in, dodge it with Kayn R Umbral Trespass and emerge toward your escape route.
Taliyah.escape: Your opening is when Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down so there’s no risk of crossing the rock field, and Taliyah W Seismic Shove is also down. If Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall isn’t back up yet, close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach to keep chasing.
Taliyah.fight: If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is on the ground, don’t dash through it; go around and close in. Deal damage first with Kayn W Blade’s Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash to prevent Taliyah from escaping with Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall, then get close and burst her down.
Taliyah.laning: Before transforming, clear camps and collect orbs instead of forcing jungle invades. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step through the wall behind the lane to cut off the escape route as your ally starts trading damage, then come out immediately. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, watch for her to affect another lane and help your allies retreat in advance.
Taliyah.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming, so don’t force fights early; focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs. Shadow Assassin has strong assassination power right after transforming and through mid game, but dies easily in late-game teamfights. Rhaast has more teamfight staying power after building items than immediately after transforming.
Taliyah.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, after Taliyah W Seismic Shove, Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, and Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall are down, approach from the flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and target Taliyah. As Rhaast, go in after the enemy’s main crowd control has been used on your frontline, then sustain through the fight by hitting multiple enemies with Kayn W Blade’s Reach and Kayn Q Reaping Slash.
Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can’t change direction during its cast, so dodge to the side instead of running straight at her. Don’t use Kayn Q Reaping Slash or Kayn R Umbral Trespass to pass over the rock field.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. Armor is also valuable against his basic attack physical damage. If a long duel is likely, get resistance first, then buy Executioner’s Calling to reduce healing.
Warwick.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow Warwick with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target you recently damaged, so land W or Q first. If Warwick E Primal Howl is active, delay your burst and re-engage after the fear goes off.
Warwick.escape: If only Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down, he can still escape with Warwick R Infinite Duress, so track both of his movement abilities. Your opening is especially good when Warwick R Infinite Duress is not back up and the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl has gone off. Then close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash or Kayn R Umbral Trespass and hit Kayn W Blade’s Reach.
Warwick.fight: Keep your distance while Warwick E Primal Howl is active, then close in with Kayn W Blade’s Reach after the fear goes off. Warwick’s healing gets stronger at low health, so don’t force a dive just because he is at around half health. Use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to dodge Warwick’s key ability as it comes in, then keep dealing damage after you emerge.
Warwick.laning: Before transforming, clear camps and prepare to transform instead of forcing a fight with Warwick or invading the jungle. When ganking, approach through the wall behind the lane with Kayn E Shadow Step as your ally starts trading, then emerge right away. If your health is below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt can let him chase you down, so give up some farm and recall.
Warwick.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early, so avoid fights that give Warwick a kill and focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs. The Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential from just after transforming through the mid game, so target damage dealers during that window. Rhaast has more staying power in late-game teamfights, after building items, than right after transforming.
Warwick.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait for Warwick E Primal Howl and Warwick R Infinite Duress to go down, then flank with Kayn E Shadow Step and target one damage dealer. If Warwick R Infinite Duress hits an ally, assess whether you can save them, then counterattack while Warwick is locked in place.

XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. His damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so lowering his attack speed is also effective. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
XinZhao.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow Xin Zhao with Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target Kayn recently damaged, so hit with W or Q first. When the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike comes, dodge it with R, emerge toward your escape route, and keep attacking.
XinZhao.escape: Right after baiting out Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is your chance to engage. Go in after dodging the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike or once Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends. If Xin Zhao chases you through a wall and has no nearby targets to dash to, you can escape through the wall into an empty area with Kayn E Shadow Step.
XinZhao.fight: Right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge goes down, close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash or Kayn R Umbral Trespass and land Kayn W Blade’s Reach. Dodge the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, and if Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard activates, wait out its immunity before fighting again.
XinZhao.laning: Kayn is weak before transforming, so clear jungle camps early and avoid risky invades. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step through the wall behind the lane as your ally trades, cutting off the enemy’s escape route. Land Kayn W Blade’s Reach after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge goes down or your ally lands crowd control.
XinZhao.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early, so focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of forcing fights with Xin Zhao. If you become Shadow Assassin in the mid game, make use of the short window to deal bonus damage. As Rhaast, look for fights where you can hit multiple enemies with your abilities, since your teamfight staying power improves as you build items.
XinZhao.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait for Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to go down, then flank and target a damage dealer. Once Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, look for a chance to focus him.
XinZhao.watch: Sidestep the rear thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. If Xin Zhao has hit you twice with the empowered basic attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, create distance with Kayn Q Reaping Slash before the third attack knocks you up, or use Kayn R Umbral Trespass on a target you damaged to dodge the hit. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, damage from outside his spear range won’t affect him, so wait until the immunity ends.

Zac.combo: If Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, approach with Kayn E Shadow Step, land Kayn W Blade’s Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and keep attacking with basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target Kayn recently damaged, so hit with W or Q first. When Zac’s key ability is coming, use R to enter him and dodge it, then emerge toward your escape route.
Zac.escape: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot goes down is a chance to engage with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Your opening is even better if the crowd control from Zac Q Stretching Strikes is also down. During a fight, Kayn E Shadow Step has a shorter duration, so don’t rely on it as an escape route.
Zac.fight: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot goes down, close the gap with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and land Kayn W Blade’s Reach. Walk over the blobs Zac leaves behind to stop him from healing. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on maximum health, so if you have to stay in a long fight, make use of Rhaast’s healing.
Zac.laning: Focus on clearing camps and collecting orbs instead of risky jungle invades before transforming. When ganking, use Kayn E Shadow Step through the wall behind the lane to cut off the enemy’s escape route, and look for Kayn W Blade’s Reach as soon as you emerge. If you see Zac charging E Elastic Slingshot, look for an angle to interrupt it with Rhaast’s Kayn W Blade’s Reach.
Zac.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early, so prioritize clearing camps and collecting orbs over forcing fights with Zac. The Shadow Assassin has strong assassination potential from just after transforming through the mid game, but dies easily in late-game teamfights. Rhaast is stronger in extended fights and teamfights after building items than right after transforming.
Zac.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait for Zac Q Stretching Strikes and Zac E Elastic Slingshot to go down, then flank and target a damage dealer. After Zac engages, step on his blobs to stop him from healing, and check whether his revive passive is still available.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges before dashing in and knocking you up, so avoid the landing spot when you see him charging behind a wall. If you have transformed into Rhaast, you can interrupt the charge with the knock-up from Kayn W Blade’s Reach. Be careful about engaging while the crowd control from Zac Q Stretching Strikes is still available.

Skarner.build: If you need to break Skarner R Impale’s suppression, decide first whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. To withstand his damage, prioritize magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so think carefully before choosing an item that adds a lot of health alone.
Skarner.combo: Approach through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, slow the target with Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and basic attacks. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only be used on a target you recently damaged, so hit them with Kayn W Blade's Reach or Kayn Q Reaping Slash first. Use Kayn R Umbral Trespass to dodge one of Skarner’s key abilities, and choose an exit point toward your escape route.
Skarner.escape: Right after you bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your opening to engage, so close the gap and fight with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn W Blade's Reach. If Skarner R Impale is also down, you can engage without worrying about suppression. Kayn E Shadow Step has a shorter duration during combat, so don’t rely on it as an escape route.
Skarner.fight: Bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, then close in with Kayn Q Reaping Slash and block his escape with Kayn W Blade's Reach. Stay outside melee range unless you have an opening to engage, so you don’t keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. As one of Skarner’s key abilities is about to hit, use Kayn R Umbral Trespass on a target you’ve damaged to become untargetable through it.
Skarner.laning: Before transforming, clear your camps fully and collect orbs instead of forcing a jungle invade. When ganking, as your ally starts trading, approach through the wall behind the lane with Kayn E Shadow Step and emerge right away, then slow the enemy with Kayn W Blade's Reach. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available, don’t stay inside a wall for long.
Skarner.phase: Early on, Kayn is weak before transforming, so focus on clearing the jungle and collecting orbs, and avoid forced fights. If you give Skarner time, tank items will increase both his damage and durability, so secure available objectives to delay his item timings. After transforming, Shadow Assassin is strong at assassinating targets through the mid game, while Darkin gains more teamfight sustain as he builds items.
Skarner.teamfight: As Shadow Assassin, wait until Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and Skarner R Impale are down, then use Kayn E Shadow Step to flank and target a damage dealer. When standing near the edge of the Dragon or Baron pit, avoid positions where Skarner R Impale can pull you inside.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain and stuns you if you hit a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. Skarner R Impale suppresses you, which Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn E Shadow Step can’t break, so keep your distance before Skarner gets close. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact knocks you into a wall, retreat while accounting for his next dash.
